minor.issue: Pre-existing parallel-run isolation flake (already documented in iteration_7). Two workers each create an active period; the 'activate deactivates others' assertion sees the OTHER worker's newly-created active period instead of the one under test. Not a product bug. Run serially (pytest -n 0) to reproduce PASS. Suggestion: assertion should re-fetch by id and check drawn/active on the specific p2, not use /active endpoint globally.

ui_bugs.issue: Auto-send WA (image + text) after new-transaction redirect NEVER FIRES. RCA: setAutoSent(true) on line 105 changes state → effect re-runs → cleanup clearTimeout(timer) on line 110 cancels the 900ms timer BEFORE it can invoke resendWA(). Deps [t, autoSendWA, autoSent] means the state change immediately re-runs the effect. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(sales)/transaction/[id].tsx:102-112. Impact: HIGH — the core feature of this session (auto-send Kartu Undian image + nota text after gallon txn) is broken end-to-end. User taps 'Kirim WA & Simpan' → lands on detail page → nothing happens automatically. They must manually tap 'Kirim Nota + Kartu Undian ke WA' to trigger the flow.

integration_issues.flow: New gallon transaction → auto image+text WA broadcast
integration_issues.issue: Redirect from new.tsx to [id].tsx?autoSendWA=1 works correctly, but the auto-trigger in [id].tsx never invokes resendWA due to timer cancellation on autoSent state flip. Manual button click still works, so only the automatic path is broken.

action_items: FIX AUTO-TRIGGER (HIGH): In /app/frontend/app/(sales)/transaction/[id].tsx lines 102-112, the useEffect's setAutoSent(true) fires immediately + cleanup cancels the timer. Two viable fixes: (A) Remove `autoSent` from the deps array and add eslint-disable — since it's only used as a guard; (B) Use a useRef instead of state: `const autoSentRef = useRef(false); if (autoSentRef.current) return; autoSentRef.current = true; setTimeout(...)` without the cleanup canceling it (or keep cleanup but don't include a state-toggling dep). Option (B) is cleaner. Also consider moving setAutoSent(true) INTO the setTimeout callback so the initial timer isn't cancelled by its own state flip.

(Optional, non-blocking) Same pre-existing flaky lottery test noted in iter_7 (test_activate_deactivates_others). Refactor assertion to query the specific period by id rather than /lottery/periods/active, since parallel workers may activate different periods.

TicketCard rendering inside ViewShot with nativeID='oxly-ticket-card-shot' at [id].tsx:179-192 works — screenshot confirms the Air OXLY Kartu Undian card is rendered on detail page with ticket codes visible.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The auto-trigger bug is due to React useEffect + state + cleanup interaction. Recommended fix: use `useRef` for the sent-flag instead of state, then the effect can guard without triggering re-render/cleanup cycle. Reproduce steps for retest: (1) Ensure an active lottery period exists (POST /api/lottery/periods/<id>/activate as superadmin). (2) Login A1. (3) Navigate to /(sales)/transaction/new?customer_id=<Budi id 7d3b65bf-2ce7-4d9c-84e1-52a1607d6f2b>. (4) Tap plus button for Air Galon 19L twice, fill bayar-input with 40000, tap save-wa-btn. (5) Assert URL becomes .../transaction/<id>?autoSendWA=1. (6) With window.open + navigator.clipboard.writeText + document.createElement('a').click all instrumented via page.add_init_script, wait 4-5 seconds and assert: at least 1 clipboard write containing 'Terima kasih' AND no 'Nomor Undian'; at least 1 anchor.click with download='OXLY-Nota-Budi.png'. Currently BOTH are 0 — will be non-zero after fix. Also re-run test_format_receipt_unit.mjs and the two lottery pytest files as regression.
